items.title: Ontario tables new law introducing stronger legal protections for victims of intimate image abuse

items.title: Understanding what's in Canada's Immigration Levels Plan
items.summary: OTTAWA - The federal government's updated immigration levels plan was published in the federal budget on Nov. 5, setting out Canada's targets for admitting new residents — both permanent and temporary — for the next three years.

items.title: Vancouver officer tells Gray hearing that union told him not to make notes
items.summary: VANCOUVER - A Vancouver police officer involved in the fatal altercation with Myles Gray testified on Monday that a union representative told him not to make notes about the incident, but that he couldn't remember who gave him that advice.
